title: Kachumbari
description: A raw tomato and onion salad, sharp with lime and chilli. The onion is soaked first so it stays crisp without shouting over everything else on the plate.
notes: Salt the tomatoes on their own and let them drain. Salt them in the bowl and you will be serving soup within ten minutes.

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.note: sliced as thin as you can manage

steps.text: Slice the red onion paper thin and drop it into a bowl of cold water while you cut everything else.
steps.tip: Ten minutes in water pulls the harsh sulphur edge off raw onion without softening it at all.

steps.text: Deseed and dice the plum tomatoes, scatter the salt over them, and leave them in a sieve to drain.
Drain the onion and press it dry between two sheets of kitchen paper.
Toss the tomatoes and onion with the lime juice, green chilli, and coriander, then grind over the black pepper.
Fold the avocado through at the last moment and take it to the table straight away.
steps.tip: This is a salad with a fifteen-minute life. Dress it when the rest of the meal is already plated.
